description: A student-run cultural organization dedicated to celebrating heritage and traditions, fostering unity among members, and sharing our culture with the broader campus community through events, performances, and outreach activities.

name: Vietnamese Student Association
description: To unite all people of Vietnamese interest. To preserve the Vietnamese cultural heritage. To promote the personal growth and pride of each member. To facilitate a mutual understanding between club members and the student population.

name: Virtual Reality X
description: We are a service-oriented organization that uses cutting-edge VR technology to improve the quality of life of seniors in our community and provide invaluable VR resources to at-risk populations through educational content and early dementia screening.

name: Vivamed
description: Vivamed prepares future healthcare professionals through Spanish medical terminology workshops, physician guest speakers, community service, and pre-med networking and career development.

name: Voicing Inclusion Thriving Awareness and Leadership
description: VITAL is a student led initiative for wellness and inclusion in the inland empire. Advocating awareness, leadership, and equitable access to knowledge and resources—ensuring that our efforts promote lasting empowerment and strong actions.

name: Warhammer Club at UCR
description: Warhammer/Tabletop gaming club at UCR! We host a wide array of miniature-tabletop games, primarily focusing on Warhammer 40k, featuring our competitive team. If you are interested, check us out on discord! https://discord.gg/CGV9uE8HTa

name: We R’ Dancers
description: Student-led organization dedicated to celebrating and fostering a vibrant community of performers.Open to dancers of all backgrounds, providing a supportive space to express yourself, grow your skills, and make connections."Led by students, for students"

name: Welfare Of Our Furry Friends
description: WOOF supports local private animal rescues and foster networks by mobilizing UCR students as volunteers and organizing on-campus donation drives. We provide essential supplies to shelters while offering students documented volunteer experience.

name: Women in Computing at UCR
description: We aim to support, celebrate, and empower women, non-binary, and underrepresented groups in computing at UCR.

name: Women In Dentistry
description: Women in Dentistry (WID) at UCR is a student organization dedicated to empowering aspiring dental professionals through mentorship, networking, volunteering, and leadership opportunities, with an emphasis on supporting women in dentistry.

name: Women in Film
description: WIF aims to bring support, education, and a collective voice to women and gender minority filmmakers, through workshops, discussions of women in the industry, movie screenings, and offering production opportunities.

name: Women In Neuroendocrinology
description: An organization dedicated to advocating for women's neuroendocrinological health through discussion of research, clinical practice, and participation in civic engagement.

name: Women in STEM and the Arts
description: WISAA aims to create a most relaxing space for individuals that uplifts as women in STEM by providing an artistic outlet.

name: Women's Business Association
description: A supportive and empowering space for college students, particularly women and students who identify with femininity, to explore personal growth, professional development, and creative expression within the field of Business.

name: Women's Club Basketball at UCR
description: Women's club basketball team at UCR. Full roster, away and home games, official jerseys.

name: Women's Club Soccer
description: Women's Club Soccer is a competitive sports team at UC Riverside. We practice twice a week and play competitive games against other universities on weekends. We promote fitness, friendship, and leadership.

name: Women's Club Volleyball
description: This club provides a healthy environment to competitively practice and play volleyball, as well as allowing campus and community involvement.

name: Women's Flag Football at UCR
description: WFFB at UCR aims to establish an environment where passionate female athletes of all skill levels at UCR can learn, develop skills, and compete in the sport of flag football while upholding values of sportsmanship, teamwork, and inclusivity.

name: Women's Resource Center
description: The Women's Resource Center is a multifunctional Student Affairs Department that offers programs and services around issues concerning women and gender. For more information, please visit http://wrc.ucr.edu.

name: Women's Rugby Club at UCR
description: We want to teach rugby to members of our UCR community and to foster a welcoming environment where members can be encouraged towards excellence through discipline on and off of the field.

name: Women's Running Club
description: We run, we walk. No pace is slow! Join the Women Running Club at UCR, where we foster well-being and social connection for women of all backgrounds by building an empowering and safe community centered on running and walking.

name: Women’s Water Polo Club
description: The women water polo club will be collegiate club that trains at UCR and competes within the state and out of state.

name: Womxn In the Law
description: The purpose(s) of this organization shall be to create a supportive community and network for diverse womxn pursuing law school. A safe space for minority womxn pre-law undergraduate students that aim to join the legal profession. Established 2022

name: Wrestling Club at UCR
description: The Wrestling Club at UCR administers a competitive level wrestling environment for students to cultivate their technical and physical skills. We provide students with the opportunity to meetup with other wrestlers and gain life long values.

name: Wushu at UCR
description: The purpose of Wushu at UCR (WUCR) is to foster the education of Chinese martial arts and to provide a productive environment where members can learn and practice these arts.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America at UC Riverside
description: YDSA is the youth and student section of the Democratic Socialists of America. We believe that working people should run both the economy and society democratically to meet human needs, not to make profits for a few.

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority Incorporated
description: Zeta Phi Beta was founded on the campus of Howard University on January 16, 1920. The Sorority's international programs such as Z-HOPE (Zetas Helping Other People Excel) through Mind, Body and Spirit serve to empower people from all walks of life.
